path.data-subject-role: Schematic section boundary between left cooler surface airmass and raised warm airmass; not a solid partition or a weather-map front glyph.
Schematic section boundary between right cooler surface airmass and raised warm airmass; not measured slope, speed or airflow trajectory.

Selected idealized interface between two cooler surface airmasses, meeting the raised warm-air boundaries continuously at one triple junction. Vertical geometry is schematic, not a physical solid wall or a diagnosed occlusion subtype.
Ground reference at the bottom of this airmass section; cool masses touch this boundary while the selected warm region is raised above it.
